title: Light Brazilian Fennel Bowl
description: A light, easy-to-make dish perfect for post-workout meals, combining the flavors of Brazil with the freshness of fennel. This dish is a great option for a quick, healthy meal during the week.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine 4 cups of water and 1 cup of dashi extract. Bring to a boil and then reduce to a simmer for 10 minutes.
Add 2 tablespoons of olive oil to a large pan over medium heat. Add sliced fennel and cook until tender, about 10-12 minutes.
Add sliced shiitake mushrooms to the pan with the fennel and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until tender.
Fluff the cooked dashi extract with a fork and stir in a squeeze of fresh lime juice.
To assemble the bowls, place a portion of the fennel and mushroom mixture onto a plate, then spoon the cooked dashi extract over the top.
